meta_description: Leading plumbing, heating, tiling & bathroom merchant in West Yorkshire. Trade accounts, commercial supplies & expert service.
paragraphs: Discover a selection of bathroom, plumbing, heating, and tiling tools at WB Trade. Elevate your projects with top-quality supplies.
Comprehensive plumbing supplies with competitive pricing and expert service from our team, stocking thousands of everyday essentials.
Heating supplies from boilers and cylinders to designer radiators, backed by IPG with local independent service.
Wide-ranging tile selection from ceramic to porcelain in multiple styles/colors, plus complete installation supplies from adhesives to Rubi cutters.
Extensive bathroom displays with professional design software to visualize your space, plus essential supplies from our experienced team.

Welcome to WB Trade Plumbing & Tiling Merchants. 
                    We are an independent, family-run supplier of plumbing, heating, tiling, 
                    and bathroom essentials based in the Ossett area of Wakefield, West Yorkshire.

We stock everyday essentials for plumbing, heating, tiling, 
                    and bathrooms—with 90% of our range available on a next-day service. 
                    If there’s something you regularly need and we don’t stock it, 
                    just ask—we’re always adding new lines based on customer feedback.

As a family-run business, we pride ourselves on friendly service, 
                    great prices, and building lasting relationships with our trade customers. 
                    Pop in for a coffee and a chat—we’re here to help.

The WB Trade Counter is at the core of what we do—built to support plumbers, 
          heating engineers, and tradespeople with the products and service they rely on every day. 
          Staffed by a knowledgeable, down-to-earth team, we offer a wide range of quality plumbing, 
          heating, tiling, and bathroom essentials, all at competitive prices.

Whether you’re picking up daily supplies, need quick advice, 
          or just want a straightforward chat over a coffee, 
          our Trade Counter is here to make your job easier. 
          Fast, friendly, and focused on trade—just the way it should be.

We are proud and privileged to be part of The IPG, a network for Independent businesses, 
            the IPG give power to the independents to be able to compete with the nationals on all fronts, 
            giving the resources, marketing support, and purchasing power.
The ethos is simple, The IPG member stores always put you, the customer first.
Not only does the experience mean that they offer
great advice
, but they also sell you
what you want

Looking for a new supplier for your essentials or reliable delivery for your next project?
      We're here to help, come down to our Trade Counter and speak to one of our team members.

Monday - Friday: 7:30 AM - 5:30 PM
